properties.name: Riverdale Regional Park drop-in area
properties.notes: County-designated drop-in drone site: gravel lot north of the Adams County Museum, west side of Park Blvd. Closed during construction as of Nov 15, 2026. No permit needed here once it reopens. Check the county rules page before going.

properties.name: Aylor Open Space, west launch zone
properties.notes: One of two launch zones here. From the south zone fly south; from the west zone fly west, so two pilots each have an area. Keep the drone in sight: rising ground can block your view. Use a visual observer. No launch or landing within 25 ft of any person.

properties.name: Aylor Open Space, south launch zone
properties.notes: One of two launch zones here. From the south zone fly south; from the west zone fly west, so two pilots each have an area. Keep the drone in sight: rising ground can block your view. Use a visual observer. No launch or landing within 25 ft of any person.

properties.name: Quebec St pull-off, south of E-470
properties.notes: Roadside pull-off on Quebec St just south of E-470. Straight up and down only: stay over the shoulder, never over the traffic lanes. Private land on both sides. Airspace clear when checked Nov 15, 2026.

properties.name: Brighton Rd pull-off, at Platte River Blvd
properties.notes: Roadside pull-off on Brighton Rd at Platte River Blvd. Straight up and down only: stay over the shoulder, never over the traffic lanes. The dirt lot to the east is private (hotel parcel), permission needed. Airspace clear when checked Nov 15, 2026.

properties.name: Rocks, boulders and drop-off
properties.notes: Rocks, large decorative boulders and a drop-off beside the lot. Watch your footing when walking or retrieving your drone. If flying FPV, stay seated.

properties.name: Parking lot light poles
properties.notes: Parking lot light poles, about 20 ft. Keep clear of them on takeoff and landing.

properties.name: Street lights
properties.notes: Street lights along E 136th Ave, about 25 ft. Do not fly over the road; stay north of this line.

properties.name: Power line
properties.notes: Overhead power line, about 25 ft, at the edge of the dirt lot just south of the Brighton Rd launch zone. Climb straight up and stay north of the line. Hard to see against a bright sky.

properties.name: Power line
properties.notes: Overhead power line, about 30 ft, running north to south along the west side of US 85, east of the Brighton Rd launch zone. Do not drift east toward the line or the highway.

properties.name: Parking lot
properties.notes: Keep out of this area: parking lot with people and vehicles. Do not fly over it.

properties.name: Private land east of Quebec St
properties.notes: Private land east of Quebec St, between E-470 and E 144th Ave. No takeoff, landing or flight over it without the owner's permission. Stay over the road shoulder.

properties.name: Riverdale Regional Park parking
properties.notes: Public parking for Riverdale Regional Park. No fee. Walk the paved path to the administration building for drone permission.

properties.name: Aylor Open Space parking lot
properties.notes: Aylor Open Space parking lot, off E 136th Ave. No fee. Park here and walk about 2 minutes across grass to the launch zones. Do not launch from the lot: people, cars and light poles.

properties.name: Paved path
properties.notes: Paved path from parking to the Parks administration building. Drop-in drone area is closed during construction. Any other takeoff in the park needs permission from the Parks director.

properties.name: Grass or open ground
properties.notes: Aylor Open Space: walk from the parking lot across open ground to the launch zones. About 250 ft, 2 minutes. No paved path.

properties.name: Dirt trail
properties.notes: Quebec St pull-off: short walk on dirt from where you park to the launch zone. Uneven ground, watch your footing and stay off the roadway.

properties.name: Dirt trail
properties.notes: Brighton Rd pull-off: short walk on dirt from where you park to the launch zone. Uneven ground, watch your footing and stay off the roadway.
